_note: 영지 기능 건물(대장간·영묘·탑·경매장). village_house_* 는 필드 장식이며 이 셋을 대체하지 않는다(ARTIFACT_INDEX). EstateBuildings.DedicatedOf 가 읽는 이름과 같다.

rulesets.prop: Match the art style of the reference images EXACTLY: hand-drawn pixel art, same dot size, same limited earthy palette, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, 3/4 top-down quarter view with a ~30 degree downward camera. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. A single object centered in frame, no text, no border, no extra props. The object stands alone with nothing drawn beneath it — no ground, no grass patch, no shadow of any kind. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF.

assets.name: estate_smith_0
assets.prompt: A village blacksmith workshop seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible. Dark timber framing on stone foundations, a steep dark shingle roof, a tall brick chimney with a thin wisp of smoke, a wide open front showing a glowing orange forge and a dark anvil, a horseshoe over the door. Clearly a smithy, larger than a hut, not a cottage and not a barn.

assets.name: estate_mausoleum_0
assets.prompt: A small stone memorial mausoleum seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible. Pale grey ashlar blocks, a low peaked stone roof with a single gold star at the apex, a dark arched doorway, two small memorial lanterns flanking the entrance. Quiet and solemn. Clearly a tomb shrine, not a well, not a cottage, not a tower.

assets.name: estate_tower_0
assets.prompt: A squat defensive stone watchtower seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible. Grey block walls, crenellated top, a single dark arrow slit, a small wooden door at the base, taller and narrower than a house. Clearly a tower, not a lamp post, not a cottage.

assets.name: estate_auction_0
assets.prompt: A village auction house and market hall seen from a 3/4 elevated angle so both the front wall and one side wall are visible. Timber framing on a stone foundation, a steep brown shingle roof, a hanging wooden sign with stacked gold coins and a small gold star, a wide open front with cloth-draped stalls and crates of goods. Clearly an auction hall, not a cart, not a cottage, not a smithy.
